name: buzzputt-plugins
description: Standalone skills: image-smith, sift-the-web, elicit, and osu-pattern-lab.

plugins.name: image-smith
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop workshop for creating and refining image-generation and editing prompts.

plugins.name: sift-the-web
plugins.description: Search the web smarter, skip junk and blocklisted sites, and get answers with source-quality notes. Runs only on /sift-the-web.

plugins.name: elicit
plugins.description: Ask a few focused questions about the person's core intent before starting a vague or costly request.

plugins.name: osu-pattern-lab
plugins.description: Build a personal osu!standard pattern library from uploaded beatmaps and get pattern ideas from natural-language vibe requests.
